

```{r library}

library(readxl)
library(bruceR)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)

source("plot_theme.R")
source("save_pub.R")

```

# directory
```{r data directory}

data_dir <- paste0(file.path("..", "figs_data"), .Platform$file.sep)

```

# parameter
```{r parameter}

# ---------- variables ----------

# ============================================================
# 3. Data column names and reusable factor settings
# ============================================================


# Situation retained in the current analysis.
situation_keep <- "Uncertain"

# Factor order used on the x axis.
outcome_levels <- c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-5", "Outcome-8")

# Display labels shown on the x axis.
outcome_labels <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "Outcome2",
  "Outcome-5" = "Uncertain",
  "Outcome-8" = "Outcome8"
)

# Dependent variable column name.
dv_col <- "Rating"

# Subject ID column name.
sub_col <- "SubID"

# ============================================================
# 6. X-position parameters
# ============================================================

# Left start position for background rectangles and dashed guide lines.
x_start <- 0.4

# Manual x positions for the three outcome bars.
x_outcome2 <- 1
x_uncertain <- 2
x_outcome8 <- 3

# ============================================================
# 7. Bar parameters
# ============================================================

# Bar width.
bar_width <- 0.44

# Bar transparency.
bar_alpha <- 1

# Bar border thickness.
bar_linewidth <- 4

# ============================================================
# 9. Error-bar parameters
# ============================================================

# Error-bar cap width.
errorbar_width <- 0.10

# Error-bar line thickness.
errorbar_linewidth <- 1.45


# ============================================================
# 8. Point parameters
# ============================================================

# Individual point size.
point_size <- 24

# Individual point transparency.
point_alpha <- 0.3

# Point shape.
# Shape 21 supports both fill and outline color.
point_shape <- 21

# Point outline thickness.
point_stroke <- 1

# Point horizontal jitter width.
# Larger values spread individual points more widely along the x axis.
point_jitter_width <- 0

# Point vertical jitter height.
# Usually keep this as 0 for bar/condition plots, so y values are not changed.
point_jitter_height <- 0

# ============================================================
# 10. Mean dashed-line parameters
# ============================================================

# Dashed guide-line thickness.
mean_dash_linewidth <- 1.35

# Dashed guide-line type.
mean_dash_linetype <- "longdash"

# ============================================================
# 11. Background rectangle parameters
# ============================================================

# Background rectangle transparency.
rect_alpha <- 0.5

# Background rectangle fill from Outcome-2 to Outcome-5.
rect_low_fill  <- "#DCEAF7"


# Background rectangle fill from Outcome-5 to Outcome-8.
rect_high_fill <- "#FBE2CF"

# ============================================================
# 12. Color palettes
# ============================================================

# Fill colors for individual points or filled geoms.
fill_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "#9DC3E6", 
  "Outcome-5" = "#A8CF8C", 
  "Uncertain" = "#A8CF8C",
  "Outcome-8" = "#F3B082"
)

# Outline colors for bars and points.
color_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "#9DC3E6", 
  "Outcome-5" = "#A8CF8C", 
  "Uncertain" = "#A8CF8C",
  "Outcome-8" = "#F3B082"
)

# Colors for mean dashed guide lines.
seg_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "#4F81BD", 
  "Outcome-5" = "#5D9C59", 
  "Uncertain" = "#5D9C59", 
  "Outcome-8" = "#D97742"
)
```

# EXP1
## Gratitude
```{r, fig.width = width_in_inches, fig.height = height_in_inches}
data_file <- paste0(data_dir, 'EXP1_CGB_data_260312.xlsx')
exp_data <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = '02_condi_long')
exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == "Uncertain", ]
exp_data$Outcome <- factor(exp_data$Outcome, levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-5", "Outcome-8"))

MANOVA(
  data = exp_data, 
  subID = "SubID",                # 被试编号列名
  dv = "Rating",                    # 因变量列名
  within = c("Outcome"), # 两个被试内自变量（谁在前谁在后都可以）
  sph.correction="GG"
) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome",p.adjust = "bonferroni")

```

#### Grati fig
```{r exp1-grati-fig, fig.width=width_in_inches, fig.height=height_in_inches}


# ============================================================
# 2. Data preprocessingz
# ============================================================
output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\01_exp1_grati_cost_stats_bar_260604.svg"

# ---------- labels ----------
x_title <- "Outcome"
y_title <- "Gratitude-Cost"

# ---------- y axis ----------
y_min <- 0
y_max <- 110
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 100
y_break_by <- 20

exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-5", "Outcome-8")
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Summary data
# ============================================================

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Rating))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(exp = "mean")


# ============================================================
# 3. Extract means for background rectangles and dashed lines
# ============================================================

cost2_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-2"]
cost5_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-5"]
cost8_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-8"]

# ============================================================
# 6. Derived x positions
# ============================================================

# background rectangles
x_rect1_xmax <- x_uncertain - bar_width / 2
x_rect2_xmax <- x_outcome8  - bar_width / 2

# dashed mean lines
x_dash1_xend <- x_outcome2  + bar_width / 2
x_dash2_xend <- x_uncertain + bar_width / 2
x_dash3_xend <- x_outcome8  + bar_width / 2

# ============================================================
# 4. Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot() +

  # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome2 to Outcome5 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = x_start,
      xmax = x_rect1_xmax,
      ymin = cost2_mean,
      ymax = cost5_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_low_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +
  
  # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome5 to Outcome8 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = x_start,
      xmax = x_rect2_xmax,
      ymin = cost5_mean,
      ymax = cost8_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_high_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +

  # ---------- mean dashed lines ----------
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_dash1_xend,
      y = cost2_mean,
      yend = cost2_mean
    ),
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-2"],
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_dash2_xend,
      y = cost5_mean,
      yend = cost5_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-5"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_dash3_xend,
      y = cost8_mean,
      yend = cost8_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-8"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- bar: group mean ----------
  geom_bar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Outcome,
      y = mean_value,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    stat = "identity",
    width = bar_width,
    alpha = bar_alpha,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = bar_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- individual points ----------
  geom_jitter(
    data = exp_data,
    aes(
      x = Outcome,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      fill = Outcome,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = point_jitter_width,
    height = point_jitter_height,
    size = point_size,
    shape = point_shape,
    stroke = point_stroke,
    alpha = point_alpha,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # ---------- error bars ----------
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Outcome,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- labels ----------
  xlab(x_title) +
  ylab(y_title) +

  # ---------- scales ----------
  scale_fill_manual(values = seg_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = seg_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(y_break_min, y_break_max, by = y_break_by),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Outcome-2" = "O2",
      "Outcome-5" = "UU",
      "Outcome-8" = "O8"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()

# ============================================================
# 5. Save
# ============================================================




```

# EXP3
## Gratitude
```{r, fig.width = width_in_inches, fig.height = height_in_inches}
data_file <- paste0(data_dir, '02_cmf_long_data_260402.xlsx')
data <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = 'exp3_bc_Grati')

outcome_levels <- c(
  "Outcome-2",
  "Uncertain",
  "Outcome-8"
)

situation_levels <- c(
  "Cost",
  "Benefit"
)

x_labels <- c(
  "Outcome-2"  = "Outcome2",
  "Uncertain" = "Uncertain",
  "Outcome-8"  = "Outcome8"
)



#### 提取risky下三个情境的Gratitude/Allocation
exp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'Outcome-8',]

tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'Outcome-2',]
exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)

tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'Uncertain',]
exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)
####

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp3】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差 
means <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')

```
```{r}
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(
  exp_data, dv = "Value", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome","Situation"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Situation", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", by = "Situation",, p.adjust = "bonferroni")


```

#### Grati fig
```{r}


# ============================================================
# 2. Data preprocessing
# ============================================================
output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\01_exp3_grati_stats_bar_260613.svg"

# ---------- labels ----------
x_title <- "Outcome"
y_title <- "Gratitude"

# ---------- y axis ----------
y_min <- 0
y_max <- 110
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 100
y_break_by <- 20

# =========================
# Legend
# =========================
legend_show <- TRUE

legend_x <- 0.5
legend_y <- 0.97

legend_size <- 50

legend_key_width <- 2.4

legend_text_margin_r <- 40
legend_text_margin_l <- 10

exp3_bar_width <- 0.6
point_alpha <- 0.2

dodge_width <- 0.8
# =========================
# Data process
# =========================
exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = outcome_levels
    ),
    Situation = factor(
      Situation,
      levels = situation_levels
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Summary data
# ============================================================

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Situation) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(exp = "mean")



# ============================================================
# 3. Extract means for background rectangles and dashed lines
# ============================================================

cost2_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-2" & summary_data$Situation == "Cost"]
cost5_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Uncertain" & summary_data$Situation == "Cost"]
cost8_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-8" & summary_data$Situation == "Cost"]

bene2_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-2" & summary_data$Situation == "Benefit"]
bene5_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Uncertain" & summary_data$Situation == "Benefit"]
bene8_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-8" & summary_data$Situation == "Benefit"]


# ============================================================
# 6. Derived x positions
# ============================================================
cost_start <- 0.4
cost_outcome2  <- 1 - dodge_width / 3
cost_uncertain <- 1 
cost_outcome8  <- 1 + dodge_width / 3

# background rectangles
cost_rect1_xmax <- cost_uncertain - bar_width / 6
cost_rect2_xmax <- cost_outcome8  - bar_width / 6

# dashed mean lines
cost_dash1_xend <- cost_outcome2  + bar_width / 6
cost_dash2_xend <- cost_uncertain + bar_width / 6
cost_dash3_xend <- cost_outcome8  + bar_width / 6

bene_start <- 1.5
bene_outcome2  <- 2 - dodge_width / 3
bene_uncertain <- 2 
bene_outcome8  <- 2 + dodge_width / 3

# background rectangles
bene_rect1_xmax <- bene_uncertain - bar_width / 6
bene_rect2_xmax <- bene_outcome8  - bar_width / 6

# dashed mean lines
bene_dash1_xend <- bene_outcome2  + bar_width / 6
bene_dash2_xend <- bene_uncertain + bar_width / 6
bene_dash3_xend <- bene_outcome8  + bar_width / 6

# ============================================================
# 4. Plot
# ============================================================


p <- ggplot() +
   # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome2 to Outcome5 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = cost_start,
      xmax = cost_rect1_xmax,
      ymin = cost2_mean,
      ymax = cost5_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_low_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +
  
  # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome5 to Outcome8 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = cost_start,
      xmax = cost_rect2_xmax,
      ymin = cost5_mean,
      ymax = cost8_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_high_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +

  # ---------- mean dashed lines ----------
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = cost_start,
      xend = cost_dash1_xend,
      y = cost2_mean,
      yend = cost2_mean
    ),
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-2"],
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = cost_start,
      xend = cost_dash2_xend,
      y = cost5_mean,
      yend = cost5_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-5"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = cost_start,
      xend = cost_dash3_xend,
      y = cost8_mean,
      yend = cost8_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-8"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +
  
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 1.5,
      xend = 1.5,
      y = y_min,
      yend = 100
    ),
    color = "gray70",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    linetype = "longdash"
  ) +
  
  # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome2 to Outcome5 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = bene_start,
      xmax = bene_rect1_xmax,
      ymin = bene2_mean,
      ymax = bene5_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_low_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +
  
  # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome5 to Outcome8 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = bene_start,
      xmax = bene_rect2_xmax,
      ymin = bene5_mean,
      ymax = bene8_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_high_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +

  # ---------- mean dashed lines ----------
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = bene_start,
      xend = bene_dash1_xend,
      y = bene2_mean,
      yend = bene2_mean
    ),
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-2"],
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = bene_start,
      xend = bene_dash2_xend,
      y = bene5_mean,
      yend = bene5_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-5"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = bene_start,
      xend = bene_dash3_xend,
      y = bene8_mean,
      yend = bene8_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-8"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +
  
  geom_bar(
    data = summary_data,
    stat = "identity",
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = mean_value,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = exp3_bar_width,
    alpha = bar_alpha,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = bar_linewidth,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = exp_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = Value,
      color = Outcome,
      group = Outcome
    ),
    size = point_size,
    alpha = point_alpha,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      group = Outcome,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = seg_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = seg_palette) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(
      y_break_min,
      y_break_max,
      by = y_break_by
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)) 
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = x_labels
  ) +
  
  # ---------- labels ----------
  xlab(x_title) +
  ylab(y_title) +
  
  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = if (legend_show) c(legend_x, legend_y) else "none",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(legend_key_width, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = legend_size,
      margin = margin(
        r = legend_text_margin_r,
        l = legend_text_margin_l
      )
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = title_size,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = text_size,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = title_margin)
    ),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = title_margin)
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = text_margin)
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = text_margin),
      size = text_x_size
    ),
    
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = axis_linewidth
    ),
    
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = tick_linewidth
    ),
    
    axis.ticks.length = unit(tick_length, "mm")
  )


# =========================
# Save
# =========================
save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()
```

```{r, fig.width = width_in_inches, fig.height = height_in_inches}
data_file <- paste0(data_dir, '02_cmf_long_data_260402.xlsx')
exp_data <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = 'exp3_Cost_Grati')
exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Uncertain', ]
exp_data$Outcome <- factor(exp_data$Outcome, levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-5", "Outcome-8"))

MANOVA(
  data = exp_data, 
  subID = "SubID",                # 被试编号列名
  dv = "Rating",                    # 因变量列名
  within = c("Outcome"), # 两个被试内自变量（谁在前谁在后都可以）
  sph.correction="GG"
) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni")
```

#### Alloc fig
```{r}


# ============================================================
# 2. Data preprocessing
# ============================================================
output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\01_exp4_alloc_cost_stats_bar_260613.svg"

# ---------- labels ----------
x_title <- "Outcome"
y_title <- "Allocation-Cost"

# ---------- y axis ----------
y_min <- 0
y_max <- 20
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 19
y_break_by <- 5

exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-5", "Outcome-8")
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Summary data
# ============================================================

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Rating))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(exp = "mean")


# ============================================================
# 3. Extract means for background rectangles and dashed lines
# ============================================================

cost2_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-2"]
cost5_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-5"]
cost8_mean <- summary_data$mean_value[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-8"]

# ============================================================
# 6. Derived x positions
# ============================================================

# background rectangles
x_rect1_xmax <- x_uncertain - bar_width / 2
x_rect2_xmax <- x_outcome8  - bar_width / 2

# dashed mean lines
x_dash1_xend <- x_outcome2  + bar_width / 2
x_dash2_xend <- x_uncertain + bar_width / 2
x_dash3_xend <- x_outcome8  + bar_width / 2

# ============================================================
# 4. Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot() +

  # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome2 to Outcome5 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = x_start,
      xmax = x_rect1_xmax,
      ymin = cost2_mean,
      ymax = cost5_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_low_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +
  
  # ---------- background rectangle: Outcome5 to Outcome8 ----------
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = x_start,
      xmax = x_rect2_xmax,
      ymin = cost5_mean,
      ymax = cost8_mean
    ),
    fill = rect_high_fill,
    alpha = rect_alpha
  ) +

  # ---------- mean dashed lines ----------
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_dash1_xend,
      y = cost2_mean,
      yend = cost2_mean
    ),
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-2"],
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_dash2_xend,
      y = cost5_mean,
      yend = cost5_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-5"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_dash3_xend,
      y = cost8_mean,
      yend = cost8_mean
    ),
    linetype = mean_dash_linetype,
    color = seg_palette["Outcome-8"],
    linewidth = mean_dash_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- bar: group mean ----------
  geom_bar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Outcome,
      y = mean_value,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    stat = "identity",
    width = bar_width,
    alpha = bar_alpha,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = bar_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- individual points ----------
  geom_jitter(
    data = exp_data,
    aes(
      x = Outcome,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      fill = Outcome,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = point_jitter_width,
    height = point_jitter_height,
    size = point_size,
    shape = point_shape,
    stroke = point_stroke,
    alpha = point_alpha,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # ---------- error bars ----------
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Outcome,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- labels ----------
  xlab(x_title) +
  ylab(y_title) +

  # ---------- scales ----------
  scale_fill_manual(values = seg_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = seg_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(y_break_min, y_break_max, by = y_break_by),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Outcome-2" = "O2",
      "Outcome-5" = "UU",
      "Outcome-8" = "O8"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()

# 5. Save
# ============================================================
```

```{r, fig.width = width_in_inches, fig.height = height_in_inches}
data_file <- paste0(data_dir, '02_cmf_long_data_260402.xlsx')

MANOVA(
  data = exp_data, 
  subID = "SubID",                # 被试编号列名
```

```{r}

exp_data$Outcome <- as.factor(exp_data$Outcome)

# 计算每组的平均值和标准误差
summary_data <- exp_data %>%

summary_data$exp <- 'mean'

cost2_mean <- as.double(summary_data[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-2", "mean_value"][1])
cost5_mean <- as.double(summary_data[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-5", "mean_value"][1])
cost8_mean <- as.double(summary_data[summary_data$Outcome == "Outcome-8", "mean_value"][1])

sig1_y <- 104
sig2_y <- 109
sig3_y <- 116
sig_seg_margin <- 0.5
sig_seg_ns_margin <- 4

p2 <- ggplot()+
  # 绘制条形图和标准误差
  geom_bar(data = summary_data, stat = "identity", aes(x = Outcome, y = mean_value, fill = Outcome), width = bar_width, alpha = 0.8) +

  # worse rect
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_start, xmax = 2+bar_width/2, ymin = cost2_mean, ymax = cost5_mean), fill = '#FDE4B1', alpha = 0.4) +

  # better rect
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_start, xmax = 3-bar_width/2, ymin = cost5_mean, ymax = cost8_mean), fill = '#FFC8C2', alpha = 0.4) + 

  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = cost2_mean, xend = 1+bar_width/2, yend = cost2_mean),
               linetype = "longdash", color = "#E19A00", size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = cost5_mean, xend = 2+bar_width/2, yend = cost5_mean),
               linetype = "longdash", color = "#B95614", size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = cost8_mean, xend = 3+bar_width/2, yend = cost8_mean),
               linetype = "longdash", color = "#C05145", size = 2) +

  # 修改后：
  geom_line(data = exp_data, aes(x = Outcome, y = Rating, group = SubID), color = "gray40", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 1) +

  # 3. 个体散点
  geom_point(
    data = exp_data, 
    aes(x = Outcome, y = Rating, color = Outcome),
    # fill = "white",       # 关键：内部填纯白，实现“视觉空心”且能遮挡背后的灰线
    size = 16, alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(data = summary_data, aes(x = Outcome, ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se),
                width = 0.15,  # 调整errorbar的宽度
                position = position_dodge(0.7), size = 2) +  # 与条形图对齐
  # 原有的颜色设置
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFD06F", "#EF8A47", "#E76254")) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = c('#FBB034', '#E8630A', '#D32F2F')) +
  # 点使用加深后的同系颜色（约加深了 30%）
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FFC340", "#F27824", "#E84A3B")) +

  
  # c("#FFD06F", "#EF8A47", "#E76254")
  # c("#F8C35E", "#E88242", "#D15349")
  xlab("Outcome") + #横坐标名称
  ylab("Gratitude-Cost") + #纵坐标名称
  theme_classic() +  #去掉背景灰色
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = title_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
  ) + # 设置坐标轴刻度标签的大小为10)  # 设置字体大小为80
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = title_margin)),  # 调整y轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = title_margin)),  # 调整x轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = text_margin)),   # 调整y轴刻度与轴线的距离
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = text_margin), size = text_x_size),    # 调整x轴刻度与轴线的距离
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 120), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Outcome-2" = "Outcome2", "Outcome-5" = "Outcome5", "Outcome-8" = "Outcome8")) +

  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = sig1_y, yend = sig1_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.5, y = sig1_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "***"), color = "black", size = sig_size) +  # 显著性值
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, xend = 3, y = sig2_y, yend = sig2_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  geom_text(aes(x = 2.5, y = sig2_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "***"), color = "black", size = sig_size) + # 显著性值
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 3, y = sig3_y, yend = sig3_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  geom_text(aes(x = 2, y = sig3_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "***"), color = "black", size = sig_size) # 显著性值
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. Data preprocessing
# ============================================================
output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\01_exp7_alloc_cost_stats_bar_260621.svg"


# ---------- labels ----------
x_title <- "Outcome"
y_title <- "Allocation-Cost"

y_max <- 20
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 19
y_break_by <- 5

  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-5", "Outcome-8")
    )
  )

# 4. Summary data
# ============================================================

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Rating, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Rating))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(exp = "mean")

# ============================================================

x_dash3_xend <- x_outcome8  + bar_width / 2
```
